translations.web: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
translations.bsb: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
translations.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
translations.asv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.
